name: crate
tagline: Paste links, get mp3s. A DJ's download queue for SoundCloud, YouTube, Bandcamp and Spotify.
description: A small terminal tool that pulls tracks and whole playlists into the folder you choose, as mp3s tagged with artist, title and cover art. Spotify tracks, albums and playlists work too: crate reads the track list and fetches each song from YouTube. Runs in the terminal or in a local web window.

tagline: Film still grader: Asian cinema color, grain and halation for your photos, in the browser.
description: Grades photos to look like Asian film stills: teal-and-amber color, halation, grain, light leaks, cinema crops and vertical CJK titles. Named after the Wong Kar-wai film. A second mode, Flash, turns photos into point-and-shoot flash shots. Everything runs in the browser with WebGL2; photos never leave your machine.

name: Type Outline
tagline: Type, get stacked bubble-letter outlines, export SVG.
description: One file, no build. Type a word, pick any installed font, and get stacked outline strokes you can tune and export as SVG with the text kept live.

name: Borders
tagline: Add clean borders to images and videos and export them at full size.
description: Drop in an image or a video, set the border width, color and ratio, and export. Runs entirely in the browser.

name: Backdrop Builder
tagline: Step-and-repeat backdrop builder: stagger sponsor logos around an event title, export a print-ready vector PDF.
description: Builds printable step-and-repeat walls (red-carpet backdrops). Upload sponsor logos and they stagger evenly around the event title. Export a full-size vector PDF for the print shop.

name: Neon Clock
tagline: A glowing 3D neon clock that runs in the browser.
description: Built with React Three Fiber and postprocessing bloom. Open it full screen and leave it on.

name: Caravan
tagline: Plan a trip with friends from one link: RSVPs by a date, cost per person that updates with the headcount.
description: Friends RSVP (going / maybe / can't) with just their name, no account. The cost per person updates as the headcount changes, and the plan lives in one place. Built for a Yosemite Thanksgiving trip, but any trip works.

name: GroupSync Survey
tagline: The same personality test in three interactive formats, to see which one people prefer.
description: A survey prototype that presents one personality test as a Game Boy style game, a chat, and a classic form, to gather preference and engagement feedback.

name: Just In
tagline: Expo prototype of a social tab for the Just In design exercise.

name: Follow My Ball
tagline: An interactive 3D Spline scene wrapped in Next.js.

name: WindOS
tagline: Windows XP makes a baby with macOS. A desktop-style portfolio.
description: Bliss wallpaper and a Start menu meet macOS windows and iOS polish.

name: HAY
tagline: How Are You? A prototype exported from Figma.
